description: A savings group keeps an account for each member and records deposits and withdrawals.

fields.name: balance
fields.description: 0 at first; changed only by transactions

entities.name: Transaction
entities.description: Money put in or taken out.

endpoints.summary: List the transactions of one account

rules: kind must be deposit or withdrawal; anything else is rejected with 422.
amount must be greater than 0; reject with 422.
A deposit adds the amount to the account's balance; a withdrawal subtracts it.
A withdrawal of more than the balance returns 409 and changes nothing.
GET /accounts/{id}/transactions returns only that account's transactions; an unknown account returns 404.
account_id must refer to an existing account; otherwise 404.
